inputs.merge_note: All three auditor branches fork from the same corpus head (b8d60bc) and write disjoint paths; git octopus merge was conflict-free. All conflicts resolved below are semantic, not textual.

resolution_rules.DR1_registry_precedence: Territory IDs and names come from the locked P1 registry (state_reader/task_queue.json T01-T16), which the parent re-confirmed: T07 benchmark/dataset weaknesses, T08 uncertainty/calibration, T09 synthetic data, T10 domain shift, T11 negative results, T12 contrarian hypotheses, T13 SR/restoration, T14 diffusion/generation, T15 LLM/agent, T16 cross-field transfer. Auditor_C's advisory T07-T16 renaming is REJECTED as identifiers (a locked registry is never renumbered) but its ten charters are ACCEPTED as content and remapped into the canonical territories and the batch_006 second-pass slots (mapping in territory_remap).
resolution_rules.DR2_stance_measurement: Where auditor_A (title-only lexical stance) and auditor_C (full-text hypothesis stance) disagree on magnitude, the full-text measure supersedes: titles under-count constructive framing (~1% by title vs 6.3% by full text). Both measures are retained as advisory heuristics; neither is treated as ground truth. Direction of every disagreement is concordant, so no finding is discarded.
resolution_rules.DR3_concordance_interval: Where independent methods agree (auditor_A deflationary meta-family mass 40.2% vs auditor_C stance-regex 39.1%), the canonical estimate is the interval ~39-40%, labeled EVIDENCE (heuristic, reproducible from recorded patterns), never KNOWN FACT.
resolution_rules.DR4_removal_unanimity: Deleting an accepted idea from ideas_master.jsonl would require a unanimous 3/3 auditor demand. Observed demands: 0/3 (A: 'rebalancing pressure, not pruning'; B: 'mutation, not removal'; C: protect list, no removals). Therefore ZERO deletions. ideas_master.jsonl is untouched by this audit.
resolution_rules.DR5_flag_union: Stage-2 flags are UNIONED across auditors, never intersected, because each auditor probed a different failure mode and a missed flag is cheaper to re-check than a lost one. All flags live in this decision file only; the canonical master file is append-only and owned by Wave B consolidators.
resolution_rules.DR6_quota_adoption: Numeric generation quotas are taken from auditor_C's cross-cutting contract (the only auditor to propose numbers for every stance class), cross-checked against auditor_A's independent 25% deflationary cap (identical number, adopted). Quotas are binding on batch_003+ generators and enforced by batch judges at dedup; they are advisory for batch_002, which was queued before this audit.
resolution_rules.DR7_schema_supersession: Auditor_C's schema change (claim_direction enum; community_default_belief demoted to optional-with-provenance-tag; who_would_disagree field) SUPERSEDES auditor_A's weaker 'soften/alternate the belief field' because it subsumes it and auditor_B raised no objection. The ledger's three standing questions remain research values; they are no longer a mandatory per-idea oppositional template.
resolution_rules.DR8_enumeration_freeze: Auditor_A's saturated-cluster freeze is adopted: HC-23, HC-36, HC-02, HC-30 (and auditor_B's metric_audit_reranking skeleton, 23 instances) accept NO new instances at batch_002+ dedup unless the entrant proposes a competing mechanism or a cross-instance quantitative law. Enforced by judges, not by deleting existing members.
resolution_rules.DR9_evidence_policy: All audit statistics are regex/manual heuristics by single auditors and remain labeled as such (EVIDENCE or MODEL SPECULATION per their own reports). No novelty verification was performed by anyone; no citations were consulted or invented; no auditor conclusion is promoted to fact.

meta_template_crowding.evidence: 40 clusters, effective count 32.1, Gini 0.275 (no single-cluster collapse), BUT ~39-40% of the corpus shares one deflationary skeleton ('trusted signal X is actually artifact Y') across three meta-families, uniform across all three generators.

permutation_pseudo_innovation.evidence: tier1 archetype-dominant = 6/271 (2.2%), all already gated with mutation_required at batch_001 consolidation; full permutation surface 43/271 (15.9%) mostly redeemed by real hypotheses. The generation-time falsifiability gate held.

stance_direction_asymmetry.evidence: deflation:rehabilitation ~25:1; anti-pessimism ~1.5%, null/equivalence 2.6%, affirmative/boundary-of-validity 0%, meta-critique-of-critique 0%. Root cause: mandatory community_default_belief + why_that_may_be_wrong schema forces an oppose stance on every idea (300/300 filled, 0 affirmations).
stance_direction_asymmetry.risk: safe contrarianism against undocumented or intensifier-inflated defaults; Stage-2 novelty scoring could be inflated by manufactured beliefs (belief provenance is currently unscored).

stage2_flag_register.note: Union per DR5. Recorded here, not written into ideas_master.jsonl.
stage2_flag_register.protection_rule: Protected singletons must not be cut at the 1000+ -> 200 stage on cluster-size grounds alone; template-family members (metric_audit_reranking 23, frozen_signal_as_free_sensor 14, annotator_artifact_inheritance 14, adapt_only_component 8) must compete WITHIN their family for Stage-2 slots rather than each sending every member forward.

generator_contract_v2.applies_to: batch_003 and later (advisory for batch_002 generators if still running; binding on batch_002 judges for skeleton freeze at dedup)

stance_quotas_per_100_idea_shard.anti_debunk_definition: anti_debunk_total_min = rehabilitation(10) + null/equivalence(5) + affirm-with-boundary(3): every shard MUST contain ideas that AFFIRM a community default (mapping where it holds), or propose a null/equivalence result, or rehabilitate a reported failure as artifact/recoverable.

schema_changes: Add claim_direction enum per idea: debunk | rehabilitate | affirm_with_boundary | new_capability | quantitative_law | null_result.

community_default_belief / why_that_may_be_wrong become OPTIONAL; when used, the belief must carry a provenance tag: documented_position | practice_default | folk_attribution. Absolutist intensifiers ('only', 'any', 'unconditionally') forbidden unless quoting a documented position.
Add who_would_disagree: name the sub-community that would bet against the hypothesis.
structural_rules: Skeleton cap: max 5 instances of any single claim skeleton per shard (auditor_B's four families reached 8-23 in batch_001).
Negative-control requirement: every idea states the control/dissociation separating its mechanism claim from 'the new combination just works better'.
Mechanism-signature requirement: any 'method A vs method B on benchmark C' experiment must state the predicted mechanism signature distinguishing a win from generic capacity/tuning effects.
Enumeration freeze (DR8): no new plain instances of HC-23/HC-36/HC-02/HC-30 or the metric_audit_reranking skeleton; competing mechanisms or cross-instance quantitative laws only.
Cross-territory prompts: each shard includes >=10 ideas explicitly bridging two territories (counter to 60% single-shard clustering).
Falsification-design diversity: correlation-only designs capped; factorial, scratch-vs-pretrained, and intervention designs required in the mix.
Dedup awareness: read ideas_master.jsonl titles/clusters first; avoid re-generating covered claims.
